title: Technology Platform Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Technology Platform Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Creates production and non\-production cloud environments using the proper software tools such as a platform for a project or product. Deploys the automation pipeline and automates environment creation and configuration.
  

**Must have skills :** Go Programming Language  

**Good to have skills :** AWS Administration  

Minimum **7\.5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary  

  

As a Go Developer, a typical day involves designing, developing, and supporting scalable backend applications for OTT and digital media platforms. The role focuses on API development, AWS cloud integration, performance optimization, and production support using Go and cloud\-native technologies. The candidate will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions while following Agile and DevOps practices.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities  

  

Perform independently as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Go application development.  

Design, develop, and enhance backend services using the Go programming language.  

Build and consume RESTful and gRPC APIs supporting catalog management, metadata, entitlement, playback authorization, and device registration.  

Integrate applications with AWS services including AWS Lambda, Amazon ECS, Amazon EKS, AWS Fargate, Amazon S3, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon RDS, Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, Amazon EventBridge, Amazon Kinesis, and Amazon API Gateway.  

Develop efficient Go code using interfaces, structures, goroutines, channels, context propagation, and structured error handling.  

Define API contracts, data models, concurrency models, caching strategies, and resiliency patterns.  

Lead feature delivery from design through deployment and production stabilization.  

Develop and maintain unit, integration, and regression test suites.  

Participate in code reviews, CI/CD processes, and release activities.  

Analyze production incidents, perform root cause analysis, and resolve performance issues.  

Support deployment validation, rollback procedures, and operational readiness activities.  

Provide effort estimates, technical guidance, and risk assessments.  

Mentor developers and collaborate with architects, product teams, and stakeholders.  

Participate in on\-call and production support activities.  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills  

  

Must\-Have Skills  

  

Strong experience in Go programming and AWS cloud development.  

Experience building RESTful and GRPC APIs.  

Strong knowledge of Go interfaces, structures, slices, maps, goroutines, channels, context propagation, error handling, and Go modules.  

Experience with Go frameworks and routers such as Gin, Echo, Chi, or net/http.  

Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures.  

Hands\-on experience with AWS Lambda, Amazon ECS, Amazon EKS, AWS Fargate, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon RDS, Amazon Aurora, Amazon S3, Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, Amazon EventBridge, Amazon Kinesis, Amazon API Gateway, Amazon CloudWatch, and AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM).  

Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.  

Experience with Go testing table\-driven tests, mocking, benchmarking, profiling, and race detection.  

Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Infrastructure as Code.  

Experience implementing Blue\-Green and Canary deployment strategies.  

Ability to troubleshoot distributed applications using logs, metrics, and monitoring tools.  

Experience leading production incident management and technical reviews.  

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.  

  

Good\-To\-Have Skills  

  

Experience in OTT, Streaming, Broadcast, or Digital Media platforms.  

Knowledge of HLS, DASH, DRM technologies including Wide vine, PlayReady, and Fair Play.  

Understanding of Content Delivery Networks (CDN), Server\-Side Ad Insertion (SSAI), and Video\-on\-Demand platforms.  

Experience with AWS Elemental services including Media Live, Media Package, Media Connect, Media Convert, and Media Tailor.  

Experience with Amazon CloudFront.  

Experience with Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, and AWS Step Functions.  

Experience with Terraform, AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK), or AWS CloudFormation.  

Knowledge of Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, Redis, and Amazon Elasti Cache.  

Experience with Grafana, Datadog, Elastic Stack, Splunk, and Open Telemetry.  

AWS Developer Associate or AWS Solutions Architect certification.  

Exposure to ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, and IT Service Management processes.  

Experience supporting managed services and SLA\-driven environments.  

  

Additional Information  

  

Minimum 9 years of relevant experience in Go and AWS cloud development.  

Total experience requirement: 18 years (9\+9 model).  

Go Programming Language and AWS Cloud are the mandatory primary skills.  

Experience in Agile, DevOps, and cloud\-native environments is preferred.  

Participation in production support and on\-call activities may be required.  

Minimum 15 years of full\-time education required.


  

15 years full time education

title: Custom Software Engineering Lead
description:
**Project Role :** Custom Software Engineering Lead  

**Project Role Description :** Own the technical direction and architecture of custom software solutions, leading teams through design and delivery. Set development standards and ensure code quality, scalability, and performance aligned to business objectives.
  

**Must have skills :** Kubernetes  

**Good to have skills :** GitHub, DevOps, Ansible on Microsoft Azure  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary  

As a Senior DevOps Platform Engineer, a typical day involves designing, implementing, enhancing, and supporting cloud\-native infrastructure platforms on AWS. The role focuses on Kubernetes platform engineering, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD architecture, reliability engineering, security governance, and operational excellence for large\-scale digital platforms. The candidate will work closely with development teams, operations teams, architects, and client stakeholders to build scalable, secure, highly available, and cost\-effective platform solutions while following DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and cloud engineering best practices.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities  

  

Expected to perform independently and become a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in AWS cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platform engineering, and DevOps practices.  

Own AWS infrastructure and container platform architecture, including network topology, cluster design, scaling models, and multi\-AZ or multi\-region deployment strategies.  

Design and establish Infrastructure as Code standards using Terraform and configuration management standards using Ansible.  

Define reusable Terraform module structures, state management strategies, code review processes, testing approaches, and governance standards.  

Design and maintain enterprise\-grade CI/CD pipeline architectures, including Jenkins shared libraries, reusable templates, security gates, quality controls, and deployment promotion paths.  

Drive deployment modernization initiatives through progressive delivery strategies to improve deployment reliability, reduce change failure rates, and accelerate delivery cycles.  

Own platform reliability initiatives, including SLO/SLI definitions, error budget management, capacity planning, disaster recovery strategies, and business continuity testing.  

Design, implement, and maintain highly available Kubernetes platforms in production environments.  

Lead Kubernetes platform lifecycle activities including cluster upgrades, node management, tenant isolation, networking policies, and platform scalability improvements.  

Manage EKS platform architecture, including IRSA implementation, VPC networking, storage integrations, CSI drivers, load balancer controllers, and cluster security.  

Define and implement platform security controls including IAM least\-privilege access, secrets management, security scanning, compliance monitoring, and vulnerability remediation.  

Drive AWS cost optimization initiatives through resource governance, workload optimization, and FinOps best practices.  

Manage Helm chart lifecycle processes and GitOps operating models using tools such as ArgoCD or Flux.  

Lead Terraform provider upgrades, Kubernetes version upgrades, and platform modernization initiatives.  

Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for critical incidents and lead cross\-functional troubleshooting efforts across infrastructure, platform, networking, and application layers.  

Represent the platform engineering team during CAB meetings, release planning discussions, and change management reviews.  

Assess infrastructure enhancement requests, evaluate operational impacts, estimate capacity requirements, and provide technical recommendations.  

Collaborate with engineering, security, architecture, and product teams to build scalable platform solutions.  

Mentor platform engineers through technical reviews, architecture discussions, troubleshooting sessions, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.  

Serve as the primary technical point of contact for client stakeholders and platform\-related discussions.  

Contribute to technical documentation, operational runbooks, disaster recovery procedures, and platform standards.  

Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on automation, reliability, developer experience, and operational excellence.  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills  

  

Must Have Skills  

  

Infrastructure as Code \& Automation  

Deep expertise in Terraform with a minimum of 4 years of hands\-on production experience.  

Strong experience designing reusable Terraform modules, state management architectures, provider upgrade strategies, and policy\-as\-code frameworks.  

Advanced knowledge of Ansible including role design, configuration management, environment automation, and operational orchestration.  

Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code governance, code reviews, testing frameworks, and deployment automation.  

  

Good to Have Skills  

Experience with OTT, streaming, broadcast, or digital media platforms.  

Knowledge of live\-event scaling strategies, peak concurrency planning, CDN optimization, and content delivery architectures.  

Experience automating AWS Media Services including MediaLive, MediaPackage, MediaConnect, MediaConvert, and MediaTailor.  

Experience designing multi\-region active\-active or warm\-standby architectures.  

Experience implementing progressive delivery strategies using Argo Rollouts, Flagger, or feature flag platforms.  

Knowledge of chaos engineering, game\-day exercises, load testing, and resilience validation practices.  

Experience operating service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd.  

Demonstrated FinOps experience with measurable cloud cost optimization initiatives.  

Experience building Platform Engineering solutions or Internal Developer Platforms using tools such as Backstage.  

Knowledge of compliance frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and cloud governance controls.  

Exposure to OpenTofu, Pulumi, AWS CDK, or other modern Infrastructure as Code technologies.  

Experience with observability platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, Elastic Stack, OpenTelemetry, and distributed tracing solutions.  

Experience working within managed services environments and SLA\-driven support models.  

Exposure to multi\-country cloud deployments and global platform rollout programs.  

  

Additional Information  

  

The candidate should have 7 to 10 years of relevant experience in DevOps, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, or Site Reliability Engineering.  

A minimum of 4 years of hands\-on Terraform experience in production environments is required.  

Experience managing AWS and Kubernetes platforms at enterprise scale is mandatory.  

Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code frameworks, and cloud\-native platform architectures is required.  

Strong experience working in Agile, DevOps, and SRE delivery environments is essential.  

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, infrastructure design, and problem\-solving skills are required.  

Experience in cloud modernization, platform transformation, and operational excellence initiatives is preferred.  

Proven client\-facing communication and stakeholder management skills are highly desirable.  

Relevant certifications such as AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, CKA, CKS, or Terraform Associate are preferred.  

A minimum of 15 years of full\-time education is required


  

15 years full time education

Sr Architect
Syneos Health® is a leading fully\-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

We bring together talented experts across a broad spectrum of business critical corporate functions. Every role plays an essential part in enabling our customers to achieve their goals. Our teams are agile, collaborative, and committed to delivering—for each other, for our customers, and ultimately for the people who rely on the services we support.  

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  

  

Why Syneos Health  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.
**Job Responsibilities**


.**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

**AI\-enabled solution architecture**
-------------------------------------

* Lead end\-to\-end architecture for assigned AI\-enabled and automation initiatives, spanning applications, data and knowledge, models, orchestration, agents, APIs, integration, cloud services, identity, security, observability, and operations.
* Translate business outcomes, functional needs, non\-functional requirements, and regulatory obligations into architecture options, technical designs, and implementation guidance.
* Design for production scalability, resilience, performance, interoperability, maintainability, portability, and reuse, including workload sizing, capacity assumptions, failure modes, service limits, and operational dependencies.
* Define and develop practical patterns for generative AI, machine learning, intelligent workflows, agentic automation, retrieval and context, tool integration, human oversight, and exception handling when relevant to the project.

**AI scalability, economics \& operational readiness**
------------------------------------------------------

* Make cost a first\-class architecture concern by assessing consumption drivers such as model usage, tokens, compute, storage, data movement, licensing, vendor services, and support effort.
* Create cost and capacity scenarios for prototype, launch, and scaled adoption; identify material cost\-performance\-quality trade\-offs; and recommend fit\-for\-purpose models, hosting patterns, caching, routing, batching, quotas, and scaling controls.
* Embed telemetry, usage metering, cost attribution, budgets or thresholds, performance monitoring, quality evaluation, and operational alerts into the solution design so teams can make evidence\-based scale, optimize, or stop decisions.
* Partner with platform, FinOps, operations, and product stakeholders to establish ownership, service expectations, support models, lifecycle controls, and continuous optimization practices before production adoption.
* Evaluate build, buy, reuse, and retire options using business value, total cost, architecture fit, delivery risk, security, compliance, vendor dependency, and long\-term operability.

**Automation advancement across core technology**
-------------------------------------------------

* Identify and shape high\-value automation opportunities across Enterprise Architecture and Enterprise Technology \& Platforms, to streamline, simplify and elevate intelligence related to complex technical service delivery processes.
* Advance automation\-as\-a\-capability by designing reusable workflows, APIs, events, templates, policy\-as\-code, architecture\-as\-code, and paved\-road patterns that reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
* Lead focused proofs of value and production pilots with clear hypotheses, success measures, guardrails, and exit criteria; convert validated learning into reusable patterns, backlog recommendations, standards, or scaled implementation plans.
* Promote human\-centered automation that preserves appropriate review, accountability, transparency, and fallback paths for material decisions and regulated processes.

**Architecture governance, security \& responsible AI**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Apply enterprise architecture principles, approved technology standards, security and privacy requirements, data governance, responsible AI expectations, and regulatory controls throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Apply project guardrails for data handling, model and provider use, identity and access, content safety, prompt and configuration management, intellectual property, auditability, evaluation, monitoring, human oversight, and incident response.
* Facilitate architecture reviews, document decisions and exceptions, surface material risks and dependencies early, and drive accountable remediation with delivery owners.
* Assess emerging technologies and vendors through structured experiments and architecture reviews, separating credible enterprise value from unsupported novelty.

**Delivery leadership, collaboration \& knowledge transfer**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Provide architectural leadership at the project level throughout discovery, planning, design, backlog refinement, implementation, testing, release, and transition to operations; remain engaged to validate that delivered solutions conform to approved architecture.
* Collaborate closely with solution architects, engineers, data teams, platform teams, security, operations, product managers, program leaders, and business stakeholders to resolve cross\-domain decisions and delivery constraints.
* Communicate complex technology choices in clear business terms, including value, cost, risk, quality, scalability, and delivery implications; present recommendations to architecture and project governance forums.
* Collaborate across teams to develop reusable reference architectures, patterns, templates, decision guidance, and implementation assets; contribute lessons learned to the Enterprise Architecture community of practice.
* Mentor architects and engineers through project work, design reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing, while retaining the role’s individual\-contributor focus.

**QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS**
==============================

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field; master’s degree preferred. Equivalent experience, skills, and education will be considered.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in software, solution, enterprise, cloud, platform, data, or AI architecture, with demonstrated delivery of large\-scale or business\-critical systems.
* Experience designing and guiding complex solutions across cloud, applications, data, APIs, integrations, security, and operational environments.
* Working knowledge of modern AI architecture, including generative AI, model and provider selection, retrieval and context patterns, agents and tool use, MLOps or LLMOps, evaluation, observability, and responsible AI controls.
* Demonstrated ability to design for scalability and reliability and to analyze technology economics, consumption\-based services, capacity, total cost, and cost\-performance\-quality trade\-offs.
* Experience advancing automation through APIs, workflow platforms, event\-driven integration, infrastructure or policy as code, platform engineering, DevSecOps, or similar methods.
* Strong problem\-solving, facilitation, communication, and documentation skills, with the ability to influence across functions and explain technical decisions to both engineering and business audiences.
* Ability to work independently, lead project architecture through ambiguity, manage competing constraints, and drive decisions and outcomes without relying on direct authority.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in a regulated industry, healthcare, life sciences, or clinical and commercial technology environments.
* Experience with enterprise architecture methods, product operating models, Agile delivery, architecture decision records, technology governance, and portfolio or lifecycle management.
* Relevant architecture, cloud, data, AI, security, automation, Agile, IT service management, or FinOps certifications.

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000\+ Trial patients.


No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever\-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

The Sr. Architect, AI Enablement \& Automation is a project\-focused senior individual contributor within Enterprise Architecture. The role leads the architecture and technical enablement of strategic initiatives that apply artificial intelligence and automation across Enterprise Technology \& Platforms core technology domains. It translates business and technology objectives into secure, scalable, resilient, reusable, and cost\-aware solution architectures, implementation patterns, and delivery guidance. The Sr. Architect provides hands\-on architectural leadership from discovery through implementation and operational transition. title: Salesforce Tech Lead — Lending, Experience Cloud and Integrations (Offshore)
description:
Hi,

Hope you are doing well. My name is Chandrika, and I’m reaching out from Engineering Square — an IT consulting and outsourcing company that helps businesses find the right tech talent quickly.

Please take a look at the job description below. If it looks like a good fit for you, just reply with your updated resume and your expected salary.

Salesforce Tech Lead — Lending, Experience Cloud and Integrations (Offshore)

Delivery leadership · Experience Cloud partner portals · Consumer lending on Salesforce · Salesforce ↔ NetSuite integration · Offshore

ABOUT ENGINEERING SQUARE

Engineering Square LLC is a Fremont, California–based enterprise consulting firm delivering Salesforce, integration, and AI engineering for US enterprise clients. Our engineers embed directly with client teams — their tools, their ceremonies — with E2 engagement management and a named backup behind every seat.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Lead the offshore pod supporting a US solar manufacturer and its consumer\-financing affiliate. This is a full\-time Engineering Square role placed with the client. You own the solution design within the client's architecture across two Salesforce orgs, run code review and release discipline, and act as the pod's day\-to\-day coordination point with the client's delivery leads — daily standups, work tracked on the client's boards, and a modern CI/CD pipeline. The strongest signal we are hiring for is a lead who has shipped an Experience Cloud partner portal end to end, has led delivery on Salesforce in a lending business, and has owned an ERP integration — and who still writes Apex and LWC on the hardest stories.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Own the design: own the solution design and integration architecture within the client's landscape across both orgs — cross\-org integration, shared partner data, and one\-way data hand\-offs built on custom objects alongside the managed lending package, never inside it

Lead the Experience Cloud portal work: partner and customer sites — self\-registration and onboarding, sharing and guest\-user security, partner user licensing, federated login, LWC and page development; set the portal standards the developers build to

Lead the lending\-platform build: application intake, status visibility, document and e\-signature steps on the origination platform; design the post\-origination processes — funding, disbursement and servicing hand\-off — on custom objects alongside the managed package

Own the Salesforce ↔ NetSuite quote\-to\-cash integration: the lead backlog item — customer/account, product and pricing sync; opportunity → sales order; invoice and payment status back\-sync; reconciliation of Salesforce, ERP and warehouse data. Own the design, the error handling, retries, idempotency and monitoring

Design partner APIs with monitoring: externally consumed APIs for installer and channel partners, with authentication, versioning, logging, alerting and replay built in from the first release

Run code review and release discipline: lead code reviews; hold the release checklist; enforce unit\-test coverage, PMD static analysis and Confluence design notes and runbooks; nothing ships without QA sign\-off

Mentor the pod: set the pod's engineering standard; mentor the senior developer and the developer; run the E2 round\-1 technical screen for new pod members

Be the coordination point with the client: join the client's daily standup inside the overlap window; report status, risks and the coming week's plan directly to client stakeholders — business, product and platform owners; send the Friday written summary; raise risks early, never late

CONTEXT YOU WILL WORK IN

Two Salesforce orgs. The manufacturer runs a Sales, Service and Experience Cloud org with an installer partner portal (self\-registration, knowledge, support). Its consumer\-financing affiliate runs a separate org on a Salesforce\-native loan and lease origination managed package, with its own installer partner portal (login federated to an external identity provider). Around both sit NetSuite (ERP — the Salesforce ↔ NetSuite quote\-to\-cash integration is the lead backlog item), Snowflake (financing and credit\-risk analytics), an AWS integration layer (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS) and an integration platform. Work spans both orgs: cross\-org integration, shared partner data, one\-way data hand\-offs alongside the managed package.

MUST\-HAVE SKILLS

Experience Cloud — partner portals: has implemented at least one Experience Cloud partner portal end to end — site build (LWR or Aura), self\-registration and onboarding flow, sharing and guest\-user security, partner user licensing. title: Senior Specialist, EHS Solution Architecture
description:
Job Description
  
  

The Opportunity
  
* Join a global healthcare biopharma organization and shape the architecture that connects digital capabilities across Maintenance, Engineering, Asset Reliability, Manufacturing Site Operations, and Environmental Health Safety.
* Lead the evolution of ME and EHS from individual product platforms toward an interoperable, governed, secure, and data\-driven ecosystem integrated with critical enterprise systems.
* Design central data hubs and reusable information services that make engineering and broader company EHS data discoverable, trusted, contextualized, and available for operational reporting, business insights, advanced analytics, and AI use cases.
* Conceptualize digital\-thread capabilities that preserve business context and data continuity across engineering, project delivery, commissioning, asset handover, operations, maintenance, reliability, and EHS processes.
* Work across global product teams, manufacturing sites, enterprise architecture, data and analytics, cybersecurity, quality, infrastructure, integration teams, vendors, and managed service providers.


Role Overview
  
We are hiring a Solution Architect to define and deliver the target architecture for the company. The architect will focus on extending existing platforms so they can interoperate with critical enterprise systems, designing central data hubs for Engineering and other products, and enabling governed use of digital data for business insights and AI. The role combines strategy, hands\-on architecture, feasibility assessment, solution design, technical governance, and delivery leadership.
  
The Solution Architect will translate business and product strategies into architecture principles, capability models, reference architectures, integration patterns, data\-product designs, technology roadmaps, and executable implementation increments. The role will assess current\-state constraints, identify reusable platform capabilities, evaluate build\-versus\-buy options, guide proof\-of\-concept and pilot work, and ensure solutions are secure, compliant, scalable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  

What You Will Do
  
* Define the MEEHS target architecture: Develop current\-state, transition\-state, and target\-state architectures spanning applications, integrations, identity, cloud services, infrastructure, data, analytics, security, and operations.
* Enable enterprise interoperability: Design and implement integration patterns that connect with critical enterprise systems through APIs, events, middleware, managed file exchange, master data services, and governed data\-sharing mechanisms.
* Architect central data hubs: Design central data hubs for Engineering and other EHS products, including ingestion, storage, transformation, semantic modeling, metadata, lineage, access, quality, retention, observability, and consumption layers.
* Establish trusted information models: Define canonical data models, business vocabularies, identifiers, metadata standards, master and reference data alignment, and contextual relationships across projects, facilities, systems, equipment, documents, work processes, risks, and controls.
* Advance digital\-thread capabilities: Conceptualize and assess digital\-thread use cases connecting engineering design, project controls, construction, commissioning and qualification, asset handover, site operations, maintenance, reliability, and EHS information.
* Assess feasibility and shape investments: Evaluate business value, technical feasibility, architecture fit, data readiness, integration complexity, cybersecurity, compliance, operating impact, cost, vendor capability, dependencies, and delivery risk.
* Enable insights and AI readiness: Create governed data foundations that support operational dashboards, KPI reporting, predictive insights, AI\-assisted search, knowledge retrieval, machine\-learning use cases, and future agent\-enabled workflows. Design and build visualization layer using Power BI.
* Provide delivery leadership: Convert approved concepts into solution designs, architecture decision records, integration specifications, data contracts, implementation roadmaps, technical work packages, non\-functional requirements, test strategies, deployment plans, and support models.
* Guide platform and vendor decisions: Lead technical evaluations of COTS, SaaS, cloud, data, integration, analytics, and AI technologies; assess vendor roadmaps and architecture claims; and recommend fit\-for\-purpose solutions.
* Embed security, privacy, and compliance: Incorporate secure\-by\-design, least\-privilege access, identity federation, encryption, logging, monitoring, data classification, privacy, records management, GMP/GxP, validation, and audit\-readiness requirements.
* Partner through a product mindset: Work with Product Managers to connect user needs and business outcomes to capabilities, roadmaps, backlogs, release increments, adoption measures, product health, value realization, and total cost of ownership.

**Primary Skills:** TOGAF
  
  

* API Architecture (REST, OData, Web Services)
* Data Architecture (Lakes, Lakehouse, Warehouse)

AI/Machine Learning Architecture

* TOGAF, ArchiMate, or a comparable enterprise and solution architecture certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure Data Engineer Associate, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or comparable cloud certification.
* DAMA Certified Data Management Professional, Databricks Data Engineer, or comparable data architecture and governance certification.


Working Hours and Expectations
  
  

* This is primarily an office\-based position. The successful candidate is expected to work on\-site a minimum of three days per week to support effective architecture collaboration, stakeholder engagement, design workshops, knowledge sharing, and team development.
* Collaborate across global time zones and provide reasonable overlap for scheduled meetings with manufacturing sites, enterprise teams, vendors, and product stakeholders.

* Successful interoperability outcomes demonstrated through secure, reliable, supportable, and reusable integrations between platforms and critical enterprise systems.
